MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Fire TV Stick feels like a plausible addition to my Raspberry Pi entertainment setup because it offers a convenient way to stream on a TV.",
    "My HDMI cable and Raspberry Pi case purchases give the TV entertainment suggestion a concrete connection to something I have been setting up."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The security cameras assume a home monitoring need that my computer accessories and networking purchases do not suggest.",
    "The Echo speakers and displays do not help with my current connectivity, cable management, or desk equipment needs; my headphone purchases do not mean I want a voice assistant.",
    "The tablets add another screen when I have no immediate use for one and am focused on making my existing equipment more useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Kindle and buying Amazon Basics accessories seems to have been taken as interest in a much wider range of Amazon devices.",
    "My interest in electronics seems to have been stretched into interest in smart home devices, even though their purposes differ from my recent purchases."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My most recent purchases cluster around wired networking, computer maintenance, and organizing a workspace, which makes practical accessories more relevant right now.",
    "I often choose items that support equipment I already have, such as a Raspberry Pi case, keyboard dampeners, and a headphone mount; that specific supporting role matters more than simply being another electronic device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my entertainment setup but mostly mistake practical computer accessory needs for broad interest in Amazon smart devices."
}
